name: Human Made
why: NIGO's Tokyo label from 2010 — heart-logo tees, loopwheel sweats, selvedge denim, mostly made in Japan — sold in the US from its own site; no US store.
origin: Founded in 2010 in Tokyo, Japan by NIGO (Tomoaki Nagao) and company OTSUMO Co., Ltd. (now HUMAN MADE Inc.) set up 2016 by Junichi Yanagisawa with NIGO as co-founder.

craft_evidence.owned: no evidence: no factory, mill or workshop of its own on the store, about page or IR company overview (business: manufacturing and sales of textile products, makers unnamed)
craft_evidence.makers: no: PDPs name no factory or maker; dyed pieces say each garment is individually hand-dyed by artisans (unnamed)
craft_evidence.mills: no: denim described as selvedge, sweats as loopwheel-knit, no mill named on 63 sampled PDPs
craft_evidence.madein: 338 of 340 clothing PDPs state a country (195 Japan, 141 China, 2 Vietnam; 1 not stated, 1 unread)
craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed: brand founded 2010 by NIGO, headquartered in Tokyo (about page); company established 5 Feb 2016 as OTSUMO Co., Ltd. (IR)
craft_evidence.process: partial: PDP bullets name loopwheel knitting, selvedge denim, persimmon-tannin (kakishibu) and indigo hand dyeing in the Ningen-sei pieces; no step-by-step making page
craft_evidence.reasoning: Human Made states the country on almost every PDP (57% Japan, 41% China) and names some processes (loopwheel sweats, selvedge denim, hand-dyed kakishibu and indigo pieces), but it names no factory, maker or mill and shows no owned facility. The vintage-inspired heritage is dated (2010, NIGO, Tokyo) but describes design, not making. That is a 2 with a nod toward 3 for the named processes.
